_comment: Copy to crossmodel.config.json (next to bench/providers.mjs, or at the repo root) to add or override providers and model aliases. Merged over the built-ins, so you can also replace a built-in by reusing its key.

openrouter._note: Already built in — shown here so you can see the shape. Just set OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

lmstudio._note: Local server, no key needed. apiKeyEnv omitted means no auth header is sent.

models._comment_models: Aliases are what you type in --model and in the routing policy. Keep them short.
